name: cargus-forge
description: Plugins for knowledge management, note-taking workflows, and Claude Code productivity.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Daily notes, meeting processing, task management, and note creation for Obsidian vaults.

plugins.name: knowledge-system
plugins.description: Bootstrap and maintain a three-tier knowledge system (CLAUDE.md, rules, skills) with retrieval, promotion, and self-healing.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Iteratively refine a plan document by looping with the Codex CLI (a second, independent model) until it has no blocking feedback left.

plugins.name: adr-management
plugins.description: Create and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) as living documents — with a litmus test for what earns a record and rules for editing, reversing, and deprecating decisions.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Turn a request into GitHub issues, build each one into a verified pull request, and see where each issue stands: discuss, slice, execute, verify, ship, next.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research a question with parallel researcher agents that write sourced, cross-checked notes, then compile them into one HTML report.

plugins.name: home-design
plugins.description: Plan colors, lighting, furniture layout, decor and outdoor spaces for your home, with sourced reference material on standards, rules of thumb and style.
